description: Screenshot of Q post #940 (Mar 10 2018, tripcode !UW.yye1fxo) containing a side-by-side image of two antifa logos: the red Antifaschistische Aktion emblem captioned '1933 Paramilitary Wing of the Communist Party of Germany' and the red/black Antifascist Action emblem captioned '2017 Paramilitary Wing of the Democratic Party of America'. The post text reads 'Coincidence?'. The captions frame antifa as a party paramilitary wing in both eras, a characterization presented as the post's claim.
text: Mar 10 2018. 940. Mar 10 2018 20:29:12 Q !UW.yye1fxo 620670. BC185452-3F1B-493B-98D9-92....png. 1933 Paramilitary Wing of the Communist Party of Germany. 2017 Paramilitary Wing of the Democratic Party of America. ANTIFASCHISTISCHE AKTION. ANTIFASCIST ACTION. Coincidence?. Q
flags: The captions' characterization of antifa as the 'paramilitary wing' of the KPD (1933) and the Democratic Party (2017) is the post's claim, not established fact

description: Text-only graphic, white capital letters on a black background, echoing recurring Q-post language about division. Eight short lines urge the reader that 'they' want division via race, class, religious and political wars, and to stay strong and together for God and country. No imagery, source, or attribution visible.
text: THEY WANT YOU DIVIDED. THEY WANT RACE WARS. THEY WANT CLASS WARS. THEY WANT RELIGIOUS WARS. THEY WANT POLITICAL WARS. FOR GOD AND COUNTRY - LEARN. STAY STRONG. STAY TOGETHER.

description: Social media post with two night photographs outside a Bearno's Little Sicily pizzeria, widely reported as Louisville, Kentucky during the late-May 2020 George Floyd protests. Several Black men form a human chain shielding a lone helmeted police officer behind a railing; the lower frame is from a livestream (LIVE, 1.9k viewers) showing the men with arms linked. The caption states the men are protecting an officer who was separated from his team, outnumbered and in danger, adding 'This made me cry.'
text: These men are protecting an officer that was separated from his team, was out numbered and in danger. This made me cry. Bearno's LITTLE SICILY. LIVE 1.9k. Bearno's
flags: Caption's account of the men protecting a separated officer matches contemporaneous news reporting but is not verifiable from the image alone
Louisville location inferred from the Bearno's Little Sicily signage, not stated in the image
The civilians are private individuals and are not identified

description: Official-style White House quote graphic. President Donald Trump, in a blue suit and red tie, walks outdoors raising his right hand in a wave; beside him a quotation attributed to 'President Donald J. Trump' asserts every citizen's right to be safe in their workplace, home and city streets, which he is 'totally determined to defend'. A presidential seal watermark sits at bottom center.
text: PRESIDENT DONALD J. TRUMP. "Every citizen, in every community, has the right to be safe in their workplace, safe in their homes, and safe on our city streets. This is the sacred right of all Americans that I am totally determined to defend."

description: Dark-theme Q aggregator screenshot of Q drop #4354 (30 May 2020, tripcode !!Hs1Jq13jV6), titled 'POTUS/FBI/DOJ/DHS Action Coming Against Antifa'. It embeds the earlier Q post #940 of Mar 10 2018 showing the Antifaschistische Aktion and Antifascist Action logos captioned as 1933/2017 'paramilitary wings' of the Communist Party of Germany and the Democratic Party, with 'Coincidence?'. The 2020 text poses a series of rhetorical questions about antifa (anti-American, domestic terrorists, organized, fascists, violent) and claims POTUS and DHS/FBI/DOJ action is coming, with investigations possibly leading to '[D][F] support targets'.
